name: EffectParameters
description: Represents various animation parameters for an Effect object, such as colors, fonts, sizes, and directions.
example:
Sub effParam()

    Dim shpNew As Shape
    Dim effNew As Effect

    Set shpNew = ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes _
        .AddShape(Type:=msoShapeHeart, Left:=100, _
        Top:=100, Width:=150, Height:=150)

    Set effNew = ActivePresentation.Slides(1).TimeLine.MainSequence _
        .AddEffect(Shape:=shpNew, EffectID:=msoAnimEffectChangeFillColor, _
        Trigger:=msoAnimTriggerAfterPrevious)

    With effNew.EffectParameters
        .Color1.RGB = RGB(Red:=0, Green:=0, Blue:=255)
        .Color2.RGB = RGB(Red:=255, Green:=0, Blue:=0)
    End With

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Direction
properties.description: Determines the direction used for an animation effect. This property can be used only if the effect uses a direction. Read/write.

properties.name: Amount
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the number of degrees an animated shape is rotated around the z-axis. A positive value indicates clockwise rotation; a negative value indicates counterclockwise rotation. Read/write.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Returns or sets the character size, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: Color2
properties.description: Returns a ColorFormat object that represents the color on which to end a color-cycle animation.

properties.name: Relative
properties.description: Determines whether to set the motion position relative to the position of the shape. Read/write.

properties.name: FontName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the font in the specified WordArt. Read/write.
